headline: CLE @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 3.92 at HOU 4.64, with a projected total of 8.56. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: CLE moved -0.18 runs while HOU moved +0.37, changing the projected margin by -0.55 runs. NRFI probability dropped -15.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Spencer Arrighetti has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Cam Smith, Jeremy Peña, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Stuart Fairchild, David Fry because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
